BillHeading.BriefDescription: Changing the seriousness level for the crime of attempting to elude a pursuing police vehicle.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the crime of attempting to elude a pursuing police vehicle; reenacting and amending RCW 9.94A.515; and prescribing penalties.
